maria_cs: FYI - Zenith onboarding flagged embedding p99 breaches. They're worried about renewal impact and want credits math + remediation note before Fridays exec review.
aj_devops: Which SLO numbers specifically? Ill map to telemetry.
maria_cs: Contract: uptime 99.9% monthly, p95 text-gen <=120ms, embedding p99 <=250ms. Embedding p99 is the item.
aj_devops: Our metrics show embedding p99 ~280ms during peak bursts. Likely small-batch cold KV-cache misses and short queueing windows.
pat_account: We need a short customer note, a draft credit calc, and a 3-step ops runbook to hand to the customer. Finance needs minutes breached + avg tokens/sec during breach.
aj_devops: Short mitigation options: 1) increase Dedicated burst capacity for Zenith, 2) enable persistent KV-cache warmers for their workload, 3) recommend prompt-level batching changes. I can do 1+2 as an immediate fix.
maria_cs: Dashboard pull shows ~35 minutes total breach over 3 peak days, avg tokens/sec ~12k during those windows. Ill DM the spreadsheet to Pat.
aj_devops: Draft comm blurb to share with Zenith:

What we observed: embedding p99 peaked at ~280ms vs contract 250ms during peak windows.
Immediate actions: enable persistent KV-cache warmers and temporarily increase Dedicated burst capacity for 72 hours.
Expected outcome: reduce p99 to ~200-230ms while we tune batching.
Next steps: engineering will run a 48-hour validation and share telemetry. If SLO is missed next month, we will apply pro-rata credits per contract section 4.2.

pat_account: Good. Add timeline note: finance requires 5 business days after telemetry validation to finalize credits. Also include a short runbook for the customer's ops team.
aj_devops: Runbook snippet to share:

# Warm KV cache for embeddings
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warm-cache -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"embed-v1","prompts":["warm1","warm2","warm3"]}'

# Increase burst capacity for Dedicated pool
redwoodctl capacity set --customer zenith --burst 2

# Quick check: verify p99 after warmers
curl -X GET "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics?customer=zenith&metric=embed_p99&range=15m" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

maria_cs: I'll bundle runbook, telemetry screenshot, and credit calc into a one-page comm and schedule a 30-min remediation call. Target: comm out by EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T12:04:17Z finished for infra/kv-warmers (canary)
aj_devops: Canary looks good. I'll run warmers once ops signs off.
pat_account: I'll prepare a renewal slide and attach this thread as evidence.
maria_cs: Closing loop  DMing spreadsheet now. Thanks everyone. :pray:
